CustomField.description: Set on an extra item that holds an additional file for another checklist item (Salesforce allows one file per item). Holds the Id of that original item. Blank on the original item. The upload screen shows the extra item's file in the original item's row, and when staff accept or return the original item, its extra items follow. Text because Salesforce does not allow a lookup to Document Checklist Item.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Filled in when this item holds an extra file for another document. Accept or return that original item, not this one.
CustomField.label: Primary Checklist Item
